title: Default topology is single module
decision: Ship single-module starter; sharding is an opt-in guide + example once load tests require it.
context: Most hobby MMOs never exceed one region's capacity.
consequences: Simple first run; documented path to scale.

title: Rust is the reference module language
decision: Primary scaffolds in Rust; TS module scaffold second (2.14 IDC supports both).
context: BitCraft and most production STDB games use Rust.
consequences: C# module docs link to official.

title: Client-agnostic kit with Godot first
decision: Provide Godot (GDScript SDK, pinned/vendored MIT) and web (TS) starters first; Unity/Unreal starters follow official SDKs.
context: Godot has a mature community SDK; web is easiest to try.

title: License: MIT or Apache-2.0 for the kit
decision: Kit content is original or Apache/MIT-derived with attribution; vendor blogs/BSL code are linked, not copied; GPL never copied.

title: Pinned versions file
decision: stdb.lock (or versions.toml) pins CLI/server/crate/SDK/toolchain; scripts read it.

title: Agent-runtime neutral
decision: Agents/skills as plain Markdown with front-matter usable by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others; official STDB skills referenced, not forked.
